description: This file defines the StatusInfo class which models health status information for an application, including nested details and hierarchical children statuses. It provides methods for creating, merging, serializing, and deserializing health status objects with support for different status levels (UP, DOWN, UNKNOWN) and detailed messages.

classes.name: StatusInfo
classes.description: Immutable class representing the health status of a component or application, including status level, optional label, detailed messages, and hierarchical children statuses.

classes.name: StatusInfo.Status
classes.description: Enumeration of status codes: UP, DOWN, UNKNOWN, with support for merging statuses.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a StatusInfo instance with specified status, details, children, and label.

methods.name: unknown
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance representing an unknown status.

methods.name: fromStatus
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo with a given status.

methods.name: fromStatus with message
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo with a given status and message details.

methods.name: fromStatus with details
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a collection of detailed messages.

methods.name: fromDetail
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a single detail message.

methods.name: fromDetails
methods.description: Creates a StatusInfo from a collection of detail messages.

methods.name: composite
methods.description: Creates a composite StatusInfo from a list of child StatusInfo objects.

methods.name: composite with labels
methods.description: Creates a labeled composite StatusInfo from a map of string labels to StatusInfo objects.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StatusInfo object from a JSON string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a StatusInfo object from a JSON object.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status enum.

methods.name: getDetails
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of status detail messages.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of child StatusInfo objects.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the label if present.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns a new StatusInfo with the given label.

methods.name: isComposite
methods.description: Checks if this StatusInfo has child entries.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Returns a new StatusInfo extended with an additional detail message, potentially changing the overall status.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Returns true if the status is not DOWN.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this StatusInfo instance to a JSON object.
